tasks.spec:
You are a greenfield scaffolding worker creating the foundation of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA. This is Phase 0 (Foundation) of a larger build.

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Scaffold the project directly INTO the absolute target directory /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the TARGET). That directory already contains four Markdown planning files: spec.md, prompt_plan.md, todo.md, plan-reborn.md — you MUST preserve all four untouched. It also contains a .ringer/ directory holding this orchestration (manifest + checks) and your scratch work dir — never modify anything under .ringer/. Your scratch task directory (your current working directory) is only for writing ./notes.md. Do NOT git commit and do NOT git push; you may run `git init` and stage files, but leave the initial commit to the reviewer.

AUTHORITATIVE PLAN: The scope and stack are fixed by plan-reborn.md in the TARGET. Read it first. For Phase 0 you must deliver exactly this stack: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite; Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui (both light and dark theme configured); Zustand; Dexie.js; Recharts; vite-plugin-pwa (installable, manifest + service worker); Vitest + React Testing Library; Playwright harness (config + one smoke e2e is enough); ESLint + Prettier + Husky pre-commit; and a GitHub Actions CI workflow. Package manager is pnpm, provisioned via corepack (pnpm is NOT globally installed; add a "packageManager": "pnpm@10.x" field to package.json and drive commands with `corepack pnpm ...`).

HOW TO SCAFFOLD (handle the non-empty target): Because TARGET already holds the .md files and .ringer/, do not run an interactive `create-vite` that would wipe the directory. Instead scaffold in a temporary directory (e.g. under your task dir or /tmp) and COPY the generated project files into TARGET, or author the config files directly — either way the four .md files and .ringer/ must survive. Then from TARGET run: `corepack enable` (best-effort; ignore failure on read-only prefixes), `corepack pnpm install`, `corepack pnpm run build`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint`, and fix any failures before finishing.

OUTPUT CONTRACT — the scaffold in TARGET must satisfy ALL of:
- package.json with scripts: dev, build, test (headless: `vitest run`, not watch), lint; and dependencies covering react@19, react-dom@19, dexie, zustand, recharts, plus devDeps vite, typescript, vitest, @testing-library/react, eslint, prettier, vite-plugin-pwa, tailwindcss (or @tailwindcss/vite).
- Vite config referencing VitePWA (vite-plugin-pwa) with a web app manifest so `dist/` emits a .webmanifest AND a service worker.
- Tailwind wired (config file or the v4 CSS `@import "tailwindcss"`), with dark mode enabled and a working theme toggle.
- shadcn/ui initialized: a components.json and at least one generated UI component (e.g. Button) rendered on the default page.
- At least one real Vitest + React Testing Library test that renders a component and asserts something meaningful (not a placeholder `expect(true)`), and it must pass.
- A Playwright config plus one smoke spec.
- ESLint config + Prettier config + Husky pre-commit hook running lint-staged.
- .gitignore excluding node_modules, dist, and .ringer/work (and .ringer/ scratch), plus `git init` done.
- A .github/workflows/*.yml that installs deps, runs the build, and runs the tests.
- `corepack pnpm run build`, `... test`, and `... lint` all exit 0 from TARGET.

Write ./notes.md in your task directory documenting: what you read, exactly how you scaffolded around the existing files, every command you ran with its result, the final dependency versions, and any assumption or follow-up for Phase 1.

HARD RULES: keep it boring and idiomatic to current Vite/React tooling; do not delete or edit the four .md files or anything in .ringer/; do not add dependencies beyond what the stack above needs; make the sample test assert real rendered output; never write a passing test or lint config that suppresses real failures.
tasks.verified: The scaffold in /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn installs, builds, tests, and lints cleanly via pnpm; package.json carries the required React 19 stack; dist/ contains a PWA manifest and service worker; shadcn/ui + dark mode are wired; a real RTL test passes; git is initialized and a CI workflow builds and tests. The four planning .md files and .ringer/ are untouched.
